Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops

Class OptimizedVUflash

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.BaseOperation
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.Flash
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.OptimizedVUflash
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, OperationInterface
public class OptimizedVUflash extends Flash
OptimizedVUflash class with enhanced performance for transient separator simulations. Key optimizations:
  • Adaptive convergence criteria based on system state
  • Smart initial guessing using previous state
  • Reduced thermodynamic property evaluations
  • Early termination for well-behaved cases
  • Damped Newton updates with bounded steps
  • Caloric initialization on the returned TP state, reused by the next iteration

Each stage runs only if the previous one did not close the volume and internal-energy specification, cheapest first:

  1. Q-function Newton iteration, abandoned after 25 iterations without a new best residual and returning its best iterate rather than its last one.
  2. A cold retry of that iteration when a warm-started initialization was requested.
  3. Detached equilibrium recovery: a two-variable Newton on independent cold TP equilibria from the incoming state (wasEquilibriumRecoveryUsed()).
  4. The constant-volume equilibrium polish (wasEquilibriumPolishUsed()), the most robust and most expensive stage.

    • STAGNATION_LIMIT

      private static final int STAGNATION_LIMIT
      Consecutive Newton iterations without a new best specification residual after which the iteration is abandoned. A converging run improves its best residual almost every iteration; a run that has not done so for this many iterations is cycling (for example between two phase sets) and the remaining iterations are wasted work.

    • OptimizedVUflash

      public OptimizedVUflash(SystemInterface system, double Vspec, double Uspec, boolean warmStartInitialization)
      Constructor for an optimized VU flash with an explicit initialization policy.

      Warm initialization is intended for continuous dynamic calculations where the supplied system is the immediately preceding converged state. Standalone flashes should retain the cold default so unrelated states cannot seed each other.

      Parameters:
      system - thermodynamic system to flash
      Vspec - specified total volume
      Uspec - specified internal energy
      warmStartInitialization - whether the initialization TP flash may reuse current K-values

    • runInnerFlash

      private void runInnerFlash()
      Run the inner TP flash at the system's current pressure and temperature.

      The inner operation is reused for every trial state of this solve, so its cached second-order solver is discarded first. Otherwise the first Newton step of a trial re-applies the phase split of the previous trial. In a gas, oil and water vessel state that merged gas and oil into a higher-Gibbs-energy state and made the Newton iteration cycle between phase sets (equinor/neqsim#5036).

    • isSolutionAcceptable

      private boolean isSolutionAcceptable()
      Checks whether the state currently held by the system actually satisfies the volume and internal-energy specification. solveQ() leaves the system at its last iterate even when the Newton iteration diverges, so the caller must verify the result before accepting it - an unverified iterate becomes the initial state of the next transient step and can corrupt an entire dynamic run.
      Returns:
      true when pressure, temperature, volume and energy are finite and both specifications are met

    • getEquilibriumRecoveryFlashCount

      public int getEquilibriumRecoveryFlashCount()
      Returns the number of detached TP flashes used by the most recent equilibrium recovery.

      The value is zero when recovery was not attempted. Recovery is bounded by one seed flash plus four central difference flashes and at most 8 backtracking flashes for each of at most 10 Newton iterations.

      Returns:
      detached TP flash count

    • solvePressureForVolume

      private double solvePressureForVolume(double temperature, double pressureGuess)
      Solves V(P, T) = Vspec for pressure at fixed temperature. Volume falls monotonically with pressure, also across phase boundaries, so the root is bracketed by geometric expansion and refined by Illinois false position. Leaves the system flashed at the returned pressure.
      Parameters:
      temperature - temperature in K
      pressureGuess - starting pressure in bara
      Returns:
      pressure in bara, or NaN when no root could be bracketed

    • polishOnConstantVolumePath

      private void polishOnConstantVolumePath()
      Robust fallback that meets both specifications from the last Newton iterate. The volume specification is solved exactly for pressure at each trial temperature (solvePressureForVolume(double, double)); along that constant-volume path the internal energy rises monotonically with temperature, so a guarded secant iteration on temperature meets the energy specification. Unlike the Q-function Newton step this uses equilibrium (not frozen-composition) behaviour, so it also converges next to a bubble point and when the iterate has left the two-phase region. Leaves the system at the best state found.

    • recoverFromInitialEquilibrium

      boolean recoverFromInitialEquilibrium(double initialPressure, double initialTemperature)
      Recover a nearby equilibrium from the incoming pressure and temperature after the other VU paths fail.

      Using a new cold TP trial for every evaluation keeps a trial's phase selection from seeding the next one. The derivatives include changes in the equilibrium phase fractions and compositions.

      Parameters:

      initialTemperature - incoming temperature in K
      Returns:
